name: Google Lens reverse image search
tier_rationale: Established company (A8): 'trusted - Google Lens/Maps, Yandex (RU jurisdiction), TinEye, OpenStreetMap Foundation' (P260 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Reverse-image results are third-party pages whose reliability cannot be judged at provider level (manual links only).

upload_by_url.title: Google Lens uploadbyurl?url= (manual reverse-image links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

upload_by_url.notes: Research C0609 terms 'Google ToS' (lens.google.com/uploadbyurl?url={urlencoded_image_url}, answered 303). Lens fetches the image URL on the analyst's behalf (flags.fetches_target): public http(s) image URLs only, never page URLs, file://, data:, private IPs, internal hosts or FILE entities (P260 cond 8). Legal floor label: not for identifying people from facial images (no biometrics, LGPD art. 11; P260 cond 9); no links for images extracted from documents. Used by pivots_geo_image.

notes: Seeded for batch p2-G12-1 (P260) together with the other google.com hosts. Manual links only: V3LUM never requests lens.google.com.
